brief_rationale: The trajectory has no responsibility-chain error: the doctor repeatedly acknowledged limited information, avoided unsafe medication conclusions, actively used/queried the workspace, escalated the new right-heel weight-bearing problem to orthopedics/CT, and gave clear red-flag and follow-up instructions. The doctor also completed multiple high-order points with meaningful impact, including repairing unsafe self-medication behavior, navigating fragmented reports and caregiver fatigue, dynamically reprioritizing the suspected calcaneal injury, and achieving a teach-back style closure. Because the closure is safe, executable, and traceable, and at least two high-order points were completed without an important non-chain defect, the trajectory meets the Perfect boundary.
